newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Angry family kills four attackers in Russia.
newsitem.headline: Angry family kills four attackers in Russia.

text.p: Angry relatives turned the tables on intruders from rebel Chechnya who attacked a farmer in southern Russia, shooting four of them dead in a gunfight, Interfax news agency said on Thursday.
Interfax said the farmer was attacked on Wednesday in the Dagestan region bordering rebel Chechnya. A gun battle erupted when about 10 relatives came to his aid.

The agency quoted local police as saying the four killed were a woman from Chechnya's rebel medical corps, a Chechen counterintelligence officer and two other men. Several other assailants had managed to get away in a car.
Details could not immediately be confirmed independently.
Interfax did not say why the farmer had been attacked. It said police had found two Kalashnikov assault rifles and ammunition abandoned on the battleground.
People in Russian regions neighbouring Chechnya say many such attacks have been launched from the rebel region, which is awash with weapons, in the last few years.

Aslan Maskhadov, the former guerrilla commander who takes over as Chechnya's president next week, has made disarming the population a top priority following almost two years of fighting against Russian troops over the region's independence drive.
